items.whatItShows: Dusk/night street corner outside the Lehman Brothers headquarters, 745 Seventh Avenue, New York, on the day of the bankruptcy filing. A TV reporter in a suit holding a microphone stands on a box at right, a woman in a white floral blouse with a headset leans in from the centre-right with her back to camera, a cameraman's back fills the right edge. Bystanders stand at left looking up; a bald man with a laptop sits at the bottom centre-left. A motion-blurred city bus crosses the middle ground and the building's white LED bands with a "SEP 15" ticker fill the top.
items.subjectRegion: Human subject mass is the lower half, heaviest at right (reporter at about 78% across, 35 to 90% down; cameraman's back occupies the right 20% from 45% down). The Lehman facade spans the top 35% from 22% to 80% across.
items.negativeSpace: Dark asphalt in the centre of the frame (40 to 58% across, 55 to 85% down) is the only sizeable quiet area; the top-left corner (dark tower, 0 to 20% across, top 25%) is also dark. No clean empty area for long text; headline would need a scrim.
items.depthStructure: Three clear layers: foreground figures within 1 to 3 m (bottom and both sides); middle ground blurred bus and pedestrians crossing at about 10 m; background facade and towers at 30 m plus. Wide-angle lens, strong separation, should give a very good depth map.
items.tonalNotes: Blown-out pure white LED bands at top; deep blacks in clothing, upper-left tower and sky; mid-grey road. Median luminance about 61/255, full 0 to 255 range. Some noise in shadows.
items.cropAdvice: Works full-bleed 3:2. A 16:9 crop should cut from the bottom (losing the laptop) and keep the SEP 15 ticker at top. Avoid tight crops on individual bystanders' faces.

items.whatItShows: Wide-angle view along the witness table at a House Financial Services Committee hearing, 20 September 2007. Treasury Secretary Henry Paulson sits in the left foreground looking off to the right; behind his shoulder an aide looks left. Mid-table, HUD Secretary Alphonso Jackson (back to camera) and Fed Chairman Ben Bernanke laugh and gesture. Press photographers crouch at the right end of the table; a security officer stands at far right. Name cards, papers, water bottles and gooseneck microphones on the dark table.
items.subjectRegion: People form a horizontal band from 30% to 75% of the height across the whole width. Paulson is the largest figure at 10 to 40% across, 35 to 85% down. Bernanke at about 58% across, 43 to 62% down. The dark table is a wedge filling the bottom 30%, widest at right.
items.negativeSpace: The pale wall occupies the top 30% of the frame, cleanest in the top-left (0 to 50% across, top 25%), interrupted only by a small wall camera at 45% across. This is a LIGHT quiet area, so text there must be dark or the wall must be inverted/darkened. The dark tabletop at bottom-right (55 to 100% across, bottom 20%) is a dark quiet area broken by name cards.
items.depthStructure: Foreground: table edge, bottle, papers and Paulson at under 1 m. Middle: Jackson and Bernanke and microphones at 2 to 3 m. Background: rows of seated audience, photographers, then the wall and panelled door at 8 m plus. Strong receding perspective along the table toward the right; good depth separation.
items.tonalNotes: Dark suits and near-black table against a light grey wall; white shirts and papers give highlights. Median about 128/255, full range. Slightly noisy indoor flash-lit look, moderately sharp.
items.cropAdvice: Native 1.8:1; suits wide banners. Cropping to the left 60% gives a strong Paulson portrait-with-context; cropping the top 20% removes most of the bright wall for a darker page.

items.whatItShows: Native black-and-white film photograph from inside the Times Square crowd at the millennium New Year. A dense crowd in winter hats and hoods fills the bottom third; two very close out-of-focus heads (a dark beanie and a pale hood) block the lower right. At left, a scaffold TV platform carries a large "ABC NEWS" banner and a "You are here" sign under strong floodlights. items.depthStructure: Very strong layering: out-of-focus heads at under 1 m (bottom right), crowd from 2 to 30 m, scaffold and banner at about 20 m, buildings and billboards receding along the avenue to a vanishing point at about 62% across, 75% down, then sky. items.tonalNotes: True monochrome negative: lifted blacks (about 28/255), median 71, flaring highlights at the top-left floodlight and top-right canopy lamp. Visible film grain, moderately sharp; reads as authentic period reportage. Slight contrast boost recommended.
items.cropAdvice: Works at 3:2 and 16:9 (trim the top). For a cleaner frame crop out the right 22% to remove the blurred heads and canopy, at the cost of the foreground depth layer.
